messages.subject: Jake Essex for Borehamwood RBL?
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm Natalie. I look after bookings for Jake Essex.

Jake would be a great fit for Borehamwood RBL, and he'd love to come and perform for your members.

He's performed in over 500 venues over the past 10 years and built a good reputation for singing the classics without the corny impersonation. He's branching out to new venues now.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist from Essex. 50s, 60s and into the 70s: Darin, Dion, Holly, Orbison, Sinatra, Elvis & more. He is the act. No tribute, no jumpsuit, no corny impersonations. Own PA, fully self-contained, no deposit.

Have a look: www.jakeessex.co.uk

Saturday nights this year and into 2027. If a date works, just reply here and I'll lock it in.

Natalie

messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for Royston RBL Club?
messages.body:
Hi,

Just gently following up my note on Jake Essex for Royston RBL Club.

Jake is from £300 for two one hour sets, or £250 a night when you book four. Three 45 minute sets are £350, or £300 a night for four. He brings his own PA and there's no deposit.

Dates are going quickly at the moment because clubs are block booking him. A few free Saturdays:
Saturday 2 January 2027
Saturday 6 March 2027
Saturday 27 March 2027
Saturday 10 April 2027
Saturday 5 June 2027
Saturday 11 September 2027

He also does a great Christmas show. Saturday 11 December 2027 is still free if you'd like him for next Christmas.

Just reply with the date that suits and I'll get it pencilled in.

Natalie
